result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: restaurant names truncated in the Fastest near you carousel and incomplete meta info on a Popular card.

issues.description: Restaurant names under Fastest near you cards are truncated mid-word (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol'), making titles hard to read even though more vertical space is available under each card.
issues.suggestion: Allow 2-line wrapping for restaurant titles or use a smaller/responsive font so full names display without clipping.

issues.description: The second Popular right now pizza card shows a -20% badge and image but has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or other details visible below it (unlike Tokumaru Ramen Bar above).
issues.suggestion: Ensure every restaurant card consistently shows name, ETA, delivery fee, and cuisine/rating under the image.
